answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 61 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 61 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 261 sponsors, each risking real money. A ember of doubt is healthy, a opal of proof is required, and a echo of patience is the price of a clean panel.
